SILBO RUC65 5G Cellular Router
Secure 5G Cellular with High-Speed WiFi 6, AX3000 and Dual-SIM PoE/DC
Powered
The SILBO RUC65 is a compact, enterprise-grade 5G cellular router designed to provide blazing-fast
connectivity for modern commercial, industrial, and remote office environments. Powered by the robust
MediaTek MT7981 networking processor and integrated with advanced WiFi 6 and ultra-low-latency
Bluetooth 6.0 (BLE) capabilities, the RUC65 offers high-speed data delivery, dual-SIM redundancy, and
versatile power options including PoE IN. Housed in a fanless desktop enclosure, it serves as an ideal
edge gateway for mission-critical operations requiring maximum network uptime.
Key Highlights
•
Ultra-Fast 5G Sub-6 Connectivity: Delivers up to 2.2 Gbps download speeds with fallback to high-
speed 4G LTE, ensuring continuous operation even in dynamic signal environments.
•
Dual-Band WiFi 6 Performance: Full MIMO 802.11ax support across 2.4GHz and 5GHz bands with
up to 160MHz channel bandwidth for dense device environments.
•
Next-Gen Bluetooth 6.0 Integration: Features the advanced Nordic nRF54L05 BLE 6.0 SoC acting
as a dedicated LE HCI Adapter for Linux BlueZ host stack offloading, coupled with a powerful Range
Extender (FEM) for long-range IoT sensor communication.
•
Dual SIM Failover Redundancy(Optional eSIM): Smart, automated SIM switching based on signal
strength, data limits, or ping monitoring guarantees persistent network uptime.
•
Flexible Power Architecture: Supports standard 12V DC input alongside IEEE 802.3at PoE IN over
WAN, making it adaptable for optimal positioning without nearby power outlets.
•
OpenWrt Extensibility: Built on an OpenWrt Linux baseline, allowing for custom shell scripting,
C/C++ packages, and seamless integration with custom enterprise firmware.
